subject: Do conditional panels based on output variables work in V0.7.0?

messages.author: 889de486273d901d
messages.subject: Do conditional panels based on output variables work in V0.7.0?
parts:
I tried coding up the simple example of a conditional panel depending on an output variable from the tutorial, but I can't get it to work.
It seems so simple - I don't understand what is failing...
Can anyone see if I did something wrong?

Running example: http://spark.rstudio.com/cswarth/conditional

Source code: https://gist.github.com/cswarth/6644019

What I notice is that if I stop at line 653 of shiny.js,
    if (condFunc(scope)) {
      el.trigger('show');
      el.show(0, triggerShown);
    }

the scope variable does not contain any information about my output variable. If input variables are present in the app then those do show up in scope, but not the output variables.

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Partial example
  datasetInput <- reactive({
    switch(input$dataset,
           "rock" = rock,
           "pressure" = pressure,
           "cars" = cars)
  })
  
  output$nrows <- reactive({
    nrow(datasetInput())
  })
  
  outputOptions(output, "nrows", suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)  
})

Seems like you need to force shiny to compute it
